title: yaepblur inspection log template and decision protocol
purpose: Provides a structured per-frame and per-arm log template that separates technical observations from taste judgments, and a written decision rule that can be applied by any reviewer to the outputs of the Iris/Scout sigma and planes experiment arms. Addresses the missing step: once files exist, how is the choice recorded so another person can audit it?
